I can't answer this question because the data isn't in my working directory. `/tmp/r2run-ognd19fu` contains only shell and Claude Code configuration files (`.zshrc`, `.gitconfig`, `.claude/`, and similar). It isn't a git repository, and there are no IURC order files, text extracts, or case tables.

The system instructions limit me to this directory, so I did not look in `/home/claude/projects/dig-risk-control` or other locations. That path appears in the sandbox configuration, but I didn't read it.

**Answer: not computed.** I have no data to count "other party" names among the non-utility-respondent cases, so I can't give the most frequent name or its percentage. I also won't estimate it, since any figure would be a guess.

To get the answer, provide the 58 orders (2021-01-01 to 2025-12-31) as text, PDF, or a CSV of extracted cases. Or place them in this working directory and tell me where they are. Once I have them, I'll:

1. Extract each case's respondent, cite, and "other party" field.
2. Drop utility respondents using the listed prefixes, matched case-insensitively with leading spaces ignored.
3. Normalize "other party" by trimming spaces and ignoring case, then count the most frequent name.
4. Report that count as a percentage of the non-utility cases, rounded to one decimal.
